_comment: PostFormer full-budget CPU gate matrix (Refs #294). Binding rule: every arm in one preset shares identical steps/batch/data stream per seed; only --model (and Builder-approved ablation flags) differ. Chunked execution via train_chunk.py preserves the exact stream. Scope is NOT reduced per the 2026-09-09 clarification: same params, tokens, optimizer, tokenizer per comparison; only the execution method is chunked/resumed/parallel.

toy-smoke.description: CPU-minutes validation of the resume machinery (NOT a gate result). Mirrors the M2 toy protocol at 1/10 steps.

gate-tiny-mqar.description: S-tiny G1 gate training: full 3000-step matched budget at N64 (episode T=257, ~12.34M tokens/arm). G1 evals N16/64/256 + 2-hop + induction/copy follow on these checkpoints.

gate-tiny-markov.description: S-tiny LM-flavoured control: order-3 Markov streams at T512 feed the G2 length-degradation sweep (1x/2x/4x/8x). Same step/batch/optimizer budget as gate-tiny-mqar.

notes: S-small Enwik8 LM training needs a text trainer (train.py covers mqar/markov only); the Builder ships that before any S-small gate claim. No S-small preset is pinned here to avoid blessing a budget the harness cannot execute.
Ablation flags (--window/--slots/--no-accumulator) are per-arm additions owned by the Builder's ablation plan; the driver rejects them on families that ignore them.

Each arm dir postformer/ledger/checkpoints/<model>-s<seed>/ holds checkpoint.pt (eval-compatible), resume.pt (optimizer + RNG sidecar), train_curve.csv, train_summary.json, CHUNK_DONE on completion. Checkpoints are artifacts, never committed.
